setup: mkdir -p /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1 && cd /workspace/astrid-app && git rev-parse HEAD | tee /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/head.txt && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d8b6985d664cb92a92d9001e1952c88e370aca2b
run:
cd /workspace/astrid-app
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/checks
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config config/testing/vitest.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useTimelineSave.strictUpdate.test.tsx src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useTimelinePersistence.test.tsx src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useEditorBrowserDefaults.test.tsx src/shared/components/RuntimeConnection/UpdateResolutionActions.test.tsx src/shared/components/RuntimeConnection/InstallerUpdateCallers.test.tsx src/shared/lib/updates/updateOperation.test.ts src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/projectChatDraftPersistence.test.ts src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useTimelineSave.currentContract.test.tsx src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useTimelineSave.mountedRecovery.test.tsx src/tools/video-editor/hooks/useTimelineSave.recovery.persistence.test.tsx --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=/workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/vitest.json 2>&1 | tee /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/vitest.log
vitest_exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
printf '%s\n' "$vitest_exit" > /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/test-exit-code.txt
VITEST_EXIT="$vitest_exit" python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import json, os, pathlib, re, sys
out=pathlib.Path('/workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1')
try:
    data=json.loads((out/'vitest.json').read_text())
    rows=[]
    for suite in data.get('testResults', []):
        filename=suite.get('name', '')
        for case in suite.get('assertionResults', []):
            name=case.get('fullName') or case.get('title', '')
            status=case.get('status', 'unknown')
            details='\n'.join(case.get('failureMessages', []))
            rows.append((filename, name, status))
            (out/'checks'/f'{len(rows):04d}.log').write_text(f'file: {filename}\ntest: {name}\nstatus: {status}\n{details}\n')
    (out/'results.tsv').write_text('file\ttest\tstatus\n'+''.join('\t'.join(re.sub(r'[\t\r\n]+', ' ', v) for v in row)+'\n' for row in rows))
    files={row[0] for row in rows}
    valid=len(files)==10 and bool(rows) and all(row[2]=='passed' for row in rows) and data.get('success') is True
    (out/'audit.txt').write_text(f'files_with_tests={len(files)}\nchecks={len(rows)}\nnonpassing={sum(row[2] != "passed" for row in rows)}\nvalid={valid}\n')
    sys.exit(0 if valid else 1)
except Exception as exc:
    (out/'audit.txt').write_text(f'audit_error={exc!r}\n')
    sys.exit(1)
PYTHON
audit_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$audit_exit" > /workspace/out/I-AP-03-R1/audit-exit-code.txt
if [ "$vitest_exit" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$vitest_exit"; fi
exit "$audit_exit"
